Barbecue Chicken Sandwiches
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, February 22, 2010 - 7:39am

Ingredients




4 med. chickens
1 (29 oz.) can tomato sauce
1 (18 oz.) bottle Bullseye Hickory smoke sauce
1 (18 oz.) bottle reg. flavor barbecue sauce
1 red pepper, diced
1 green pepper, diced
1 yellow pepper, diced
2 tablespoons fried chicken seasoning
1 tablespoon garlic
1 tablespoon paprika
1 tablespoon celery salt
 cup honey
Salt and pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Boil 4 medium chickens until tender, cool, remove skin from chicken and pull chicken from bone. Place in crock pot and pour barbecue sauce over chicken. Turn crock pot on high until chicken and sauce comes to a boil, ready to serve. Serve on buns. 2 BARBECUE SAUCE: Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over the 4 medium chickens that have been pulled from the bone.
